\[
(1,1)\to(4,4),\quad
(1,3)\to(2,4),\quad
(3,4)\to(1,2),\quad
(4,2)\to(3,1).
\]
All four of these are currently white and are distinct, so at least \(4\) additional squares must be colored black. Coloring exactly these four makes the pattern symmetric about \(BD\), so the minimum is
